name: D2 lesion-visibility equalization
rule: For each ITA bracket, the smallest CLAHE clip limit whose median lesion-vs-healthy-skin CIELAB delta-E reaches the lightest bracket's delta-E without CLAHE; if unreachable within the noise limit, the clip limit with the highest delta-E.
data: calibration-eligible TRAIN images with lesion boxes only

reasons.Darkest: target not reachable; highest lesion visibility (10.70)
